Demeter Cave House, Pyrgos, Santorini, Greece Skip to content
Demeter Cave House - Santorini
''A dreamily romantic, adults-only hideaway tucked into the heart of Santorini’s prettiest village, Pyrgos''
If you’re seeking a place to slow down, reconnect, and soak in the magic of Santorini—welcome.
Demeter Cave House is a beautifully restored, heritage cave home designed just for two. Hidden behind thick whitewashed walls in the quiet village of Pyrgos, it offers something rare: luxury, privacy, and stillness.
Read More
Inside, you’ll find soft curves, vaulted ceilings, and handpicked design touches that feel both authentic and refined. There’s an airy domed living area, a compact kitchenette, a super-comfy double bedroom, and a cave-style bathroom with a luxurious couples’ rain shower. Step outside into your private courtyard with a heated jacuzzi, or climb up to the panoramic roof terrace for sweeping views over Pyrgos and out to the Aegean Sea.
And though the famous caldera is only a five-minute drive away, many of our guests prefer to stay right here—sipping wine at sunset above the rooftops, watching church bells chime, and letting the quiet charm of Pyrgos unfold at its own gentle pace.
The village itself is a treasure: cobbled lanes, blue-domed chapels, crumbling castle walls, and authentic tavernas where locals gather for meze and laughter. From here, you’re well-placed to explore all of Santorini—from the black sand beaches of the east coast to the vibrant heart of Fira and the volcanic islets beyond.
Demeter Cave House is more than a place to stay. It’s a moment to exhale. A retreat made for romance. And an invitation to experience the island as it once was—peaceful, beautiful, and entirely unforgettable.

Pyrgos Village, Santorini
Luxury Santorini Cave House in Pyrgos Village, Santorini
Once the administrative centre for Santorini, Pyrgos is now the most beautiful preserved village on the island. To say it’s postcard perfect is an understatement. With a medieval castle, no less than 46 churches and whitewashed cave houses set around squares draped in bougainvillea, Pyrgos is often refered to as the hidden gem of Santorini.

Luxury Cave House, Pyrgos, Santorini Accommodation
You’ll feel immediately at home the moment you enter Demeter Cave House. The curvaceous walls and classic whitewashed Cycladic interiors are soothing and cool. There’s a spacious open plan kitchen/lounge, a separate bedroom with super-comfy king size bed and a couple’s drench shower in the bathroom.
Outside, there’s a cosy private courtyard with heated jacuzzi and a seating area perfect for relaxing, reading or enjoying an al-fresco breakfast. The large panoramic roof terrace zooms in on the beauty of Pyrgos village and dazzling blue of the Aegean Sea.
